e.title: **英国 MOT 车检的**队列统计**：样本只给 Volvo，**而且许可写明「**evaluation only**」**：Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`——**⭐ 一句值得抄的话**：**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data — the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**；**⭐ 而「**工程**」指的是**两件事**：**把 **4,030 个原始车型字符串归一成 **347 个车型**（**全英 **216,686 个品牌车型组合、**覆盖率 **98.72%****）**，**以及一个**五档缺陷严重度分类**；**⚠️ 许可为**仅评估用、**不得再分发、**不得用于核保或生产**
e.title_en: A cohort-level UK vehicle-inspection reliability dataset published as a Volvo-only evaluation sample under a licence that permits inspection but not redistribution or production use, whose stated value is not the raw open-government feed but the normalisation of thousands of free-text model strings into hundreds of models and a five-tier defect severity taxonomy.
e.title_hk: **英國 MOT 車檢的**隊列統計**：樣本只給 Volvo，**而且許可寫明「**evaluation only**」**：Kaggle 資料集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`——**⭐ 一句值得抄的話**：**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data — the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**；**⭐ 而「**工程**」指的是**兩件事**：**把 **4,030 個原始車型字串歸一成 **347 個車型**（**全英 **216,686 個品牌車型組合、**覆蓋率 **98.72%****）**，**以及一個**五檔缺陷嚴重度分類**；**⚠️ 許可為**僅評估用、**不得再分發、**不得用於核保或生產**
e.summary: **uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`）**是一份**英国车辆可靠性队列统计**的**免费评估样本****——**逐字自述为从 DVSA MOT 检验记录派生的队列级统计**（**首次通过率、**缺陷模式、**严重度分类、**里程分段行为与**生存曲线**，**粒度到**品牌 × 车型 × 制造年 × 燃料类型**）**，**并逐字标明**「**This is a free evaluation sample covering Volvo only.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 字节**、**可用性评分 0.94**、**下载 20 次、**收藏 4**；**标签含** insurance**；**⭐ 许可逐字为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：抽样**」**——**⭐ 它给的三条纪律最值得抄**：**① **「**免费的是原始数据，不是这层工程**」**（**逐字**「**The DVSA feed has no model taxonomy, only free-text trim strings**」**）**；**② **只给聚合、**并逐字声明没有个人数据**（**逐字**「**no registration marks, no VINs, no keeper or owner identity, and no per-vehicle rows**」**）**；**③ **许可写明**仅评估、**不得再分发、**不得进生产或核保**。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件。
e.summary_hk: **uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 資料集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`）**是一份**英國車輛可靠性隊列統計**的**免費評估樣本****——**逐字自述為從 DVSA MOT 檢驗記錄派生的隊列級統計**（**首次通過率、**缺陷模式、**嚴重度分類、**里程分段行為與**生存曲線**，**粒度到**品牌 × 車型 × 製造年 × 燃料類型**）**，**並逐字標明**「**This is a free evaluation sample covering Volvo only.**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 20 次、**收藏 4**；**標籤含** insurance**；**⭐ 許可逐字為**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：抽樣**」**——**⭐ 三條紀律最值得抄**：**① **「**免費的是原始資料，不是這層工程**」**；**② **只給聚合、**並逐字聲明沒有個人資料**；**③ **許可寫明**僅評估、**不得再分發、**不得進生產或核保**。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案。
e.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset **is a free evaluation sample of cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics**, described verbatim as cohort-level statistics derived from vehicle inspection records covering first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at the grain of make, model, manufacture year and fuel type, and stated verbatim to be a free evaluation sample covering one make only. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 4**, **about 1.2 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, twenty downloads and four votes, tagged with insurance, and **licensed as other with the terms specified in the description**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case sampling**, and **three disciplines are worth copying: the free thing is the raw feed rather than this engineering layer, only aggregates are published with an explicit statement that no registration marks, vehicle identification numbers, keeper identities or per-vehicle rows are present at any tier, and the licence states plainly that the sample is for evaluation only and may not be redistributed or used in production, underwriting or a paid service**. **No file was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 数据集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`，**逐字标题** `UK Vehicle Reliability: Volvo MOT Sample`**）**是一份**英国车辆可靠性队列统计**的**免费评估样本****——**逐字自述为**「**Cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics derived from DVSA MOT test records: first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at make × model × manufacture year × fuel type.**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 字节**、**可用性评分 **0.94****、**下载 20 次、**浏览 45 次、**收藏 4、**公开 notebook 1 个**；**标签逐字含** `tabular`、`automobiles and vehicles`、`transportation`、`insurance`**；**所有者与创建者同为一人**（`DonaldMSimpson`**）**；**⭐ 许可字段逐字为**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：抽样**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页的元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一句话划清了「**免费的是什么**」**——**逐字**：**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data - the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. **This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**原始数据是公共的**」**与**「**能用来做队列统计的那一层不是**」**被一句话分开**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**免费的源头 ＋ 收费的加工层**，**而**作者**没有**把两者混在一起说**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 而「**工程**」被具体化成一个**可核的归一化比例****——**逐字**：**「**The DVSA feed has **no model taxonomy**, only free-text trim strings. For Volvo alone the source holds **4,030 raw model strings** which normalise to **347 models**」**，**并给出四行对照例**（`XC60 + B5 MHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 ULTRA T8 PHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 + BLK ED B5 MHEV AWD AUTO`、`XC60 ULTIMTE T8 RECHARGE AWD A` **均归为** `XC60`**）**；**⭐ 全英范围逐字为**「**Across the full UK bundle the source holds **216,686** distinct make-and-model combinations; normalisation coverage is **98.72%**.**」**，**并逐字说明**「**The join is documented in `NORMALISATION.md`, which is itself part of the product.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**4,030 → 347**」**这个比值**就是**「**为什么 MOT 数据不能直接按车型分组**」**的答案**；**⭐ 而**归一化规则本身被当作**产品的一部分**公开**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 缺陷严重度分类被说明**哪些部分是原始数据里拿不到的****——**逐字**：**「**A hand-built severity model applied at approximately **1.87 billion** defect rows in production, rolled up to cohort level. Raw MOT gives you a text blob; this gives you weighted severity by tier (`advisory`, `safety_wear`, `mechanical_safety`, `structural_concern`, `dangerous`). **This is the part that is not recoverable from the raw feed.** Raw MOT failure text is dominated by consumables - tyres and brakes top almost every cohort, which tells you nothing. The taxonomy separates structural failure (corrosion, mounts, subframes - expensive, often terminal) from routine wear.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是整份说明里最有信息量的一段**：**⭐ 它先说**原始失败文本被耗材（**轮胎与刹车**）主导**、**因此「**什么都说明不了**」，**再说**自己的分类**把结构性失效**（**锈蚀、**机脚、**副车架**）**与**例行磨损**分开**——**⭐ 即**「**我加的不是数据，是分得清的类别**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 五处「**已替你修正**」被逐条命名****——**逐字五条**：**① **未完成结果的抑制**（**结果历史不完整时** `pass_rate_reliable = false`**）**；**② **里程异常分离**（**真实调表约 **4.5%**，**与**打错与单位错误**分开**）**；**③ **里程单位不可混**（**`MI`／`KM` 标签约 **0.6%** 标错，**逐字**「**do not average across units**」**）**；**④ **混合动力按内燃机归类**；**⑤ **复检不计入首次结果**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**如果我不管，这个天真管线会掉进哪些坑**」**被写成五条**——**⭐ 这与本站第 335 轮「**不要悄悄降级**」、第 347 轮「**防误读**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 「**产出文件 ＋ 每份行数**」被列表写明**——**实测描述中六个 parquet 与一个 CSV 逐字为**：`volvo_cohort_stats.parquet` **2,094 行**、`volvo_defect_patterns.parquet` **5,029 行**、`volvo_defect_severity.parquet` **6,284 行**、`volvo_survival.parquet` **9,844 行**、`volvo_mileage_band_pass.parquet` **2,860 行**、`volvo_mileage_percentiles.parquet` **175 行**、`volvo_preview.csv` **20 行**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**Every file carries `snapshot_date`, `generated_at` and `source`**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**每个文件都带快照日期与来源**」**这一条最实用**：**⭐ 即**拿到文件的人**不必去猜它是哪天的切片**——**⭐ 快照日逐字为** `2026-09-06`**、**筛选条件逐字为** `vehicle_count > 50`**、**队列数 **2,094****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 局限被逐条写出，**并指出一个**最容易用错的字段****——**逐字含**：**仅 MOT 记录**（**无融资、**全损、**失窃标记或车主历史**）**；**小于阈值的队列被排除**（**样本噪声大**）**；**`pass_rate_reliable = false` 的队列**须过滤掉**；**燃料标签来自 DVSA 且不完美**（**混动按内燃机归类**）**；**⭐ 以及**「**`vehicle_count` is not the mileage denominator. Use `mileage_sample_count`**」**，**并给出一个具体反例**「**the 1988 `340` has **14,085 vehicles and zero usable readings**, so its `avg_mileage` is `NULL`**」**；**以及**「**Snapshot, not a live feed.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为那个「**14,085 辆车、**零条可用读数**」**的例子极值得抄**：**⭐ 即**一个列名**（`vehicle_count`）**看起来像分母**，**其实不是**——**⭐ 而**指出这一点**只需要一个反例**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 许可与归属被分成**三层写清****——**逐字**：**① **许可**「**evaluation only - this is **not** an open dataset**」**，**并逐字限定**「**You may download, inspect and evaluate it. You may not redistribute it or use it in a production product, underwriting model or paid service without a commercial licence.**」**；**② **公共部门信息**「**Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.**」**；**③ **派生字段归属**「**CarHunch-derived fields (normalisation, severity taxonomy, cohort statistics, survival curves and related analysis) are © Donald Simpson Limited.**」**，**并逐字声明**「**CarHunch is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, DVSA or DVLA.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是**三层归属**（**许可／**公共部门信息／**派生字段**）**的干净写法**——**⭐ 与之对照**：**本站第 358 轮那条退休计算器**把数据许可与代码许可分开**，**而这一条**把**同一份数据里的三种权利**分开**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 「**同一份样本、三个平台**」被写明**——**逐字给出**完整数据集与许可的联系页（`carhunch.com/data`**）、**同一份样本在 Hugging Face 的地址**、**以及**在 GitHub 的地址**，**并逐字说明**「**This is not an export made for sale - it is the layer behind a live public site, so you can inspect the same figures rendered for humans at carhunch.com before licensing the files.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**你可以先在网页上看同一批数字，**再决定要不要买文件**」**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**：**同一内容以**网页、**HF、**GitHub、**Kaggle 四种形态出现**，**而**哪一种可再分发**被写明**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 覆盖范围与用途被写明**——**逐字**：**全量包覆盖** MOT **classes 1–7**（**含**摩托车与轻型商用车**，**并列出若干品牌**）**；**而**本样本按定义只有汽车**；**用途逐字列出五类**（**二手车保修与核保**、**经销商／拍卖／再营销工具**、**配件与服务修复平台**、**车辆数据商与车队分析**、**研究者与记者**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**用途一栏里的「**with a structural-versus-routine-wear split for reserving**」**值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它明确指向**准备金**用途**，**而**许可却禁止**未经商业许可用于核保或生产**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两句**，**不替它调和**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程细节与可复现入口**——**实测描述给出** `pandas` 与 **DuckDB** 两种读法**，**并给出**最小示例**（**按 `pass_rate_reliable` 过滤后取 `pct_with_dangerous_defect` 最大的十个队列**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**「**先过滤可靠性标记、**再排序**」**这个顺序本身**就是纪律**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、**[[insurance-datasets]] 覆盖保险数据资源一侧**，**[[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]] 覆盖英国的风险地图**，**[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 覆盖事故车残值一侧**，**[[insurance-data-tools]]、**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖数据工具与合成数据**，**[[stressed-insurance-datasets]] 覆盖压力化数据集**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**只给聚合、**只给一个品牌、**并写明仅评估用**的车检统计样本 ＋**把「**哪一层是免费的、**哪一层是加工出来的**」写成一句话**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]]、[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **许可要写明能做什么、**不能做什么**（**含**不得进生产与核保**）**；**② **只发聚合时**逐字声明没有个人数据**；**③ **每个文件带**快照日期与来源**；**④ **把「**看起来像分母但其实是分母**」的字段**用一个反例指出来**；**⑤ **同一份内容在多平台上时**，**说清哪一版可再分发**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取任何 parquet 或 CSV、**未计算任何通过率或生存曲线**），**故**不主张**其行数以外的任何数值结果**（**⭐ 行数亦只来自描述中的表格**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实 Kaggle 的**下载是否需要登录**——**⭐ 本次**只用公开的元数据接口取到描述**，**未尝试下载文件**；**⭐ 故**「**免费评估样本**」**在实际取用环节是否需要账号**，**本次**未核实**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** 4,030 → 347**、**216,686**、**98.72%**、**1.87 billion** 与 **4.5%／0.6%** 这些数字**（**⭐ 本词条只转述描述**）**；**⚠️ 特别是**「**约 18.7 亿行缺陷记录**」**这一规模，**本次**无任何独立核对**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `volvo_cohort_stats.parquet` **等文件的**实际列名**（**描述称** `SCHEMA.md` **有完整文档，**但该文件**可能在完整包里、**本次未取得**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `pass_rate_reliable` **这一标记**在数据里**如何取值与占比**（**⭐ 描述只说**须过滤**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**生存曲线**的具体定义**（**描述只说**「**how many vehicles from a manufacture year are still being MOT-tested in later years**」**）**；**也未核实** 1988 年 `340` 那个反例**是否与数据一致**。**⑦ ⚠️ **许可须逐条遵守**：**⭐ 本条**明确提示**——**该数据集**不是开放数据**，**不得再分发、**不得用于生产、**核保或付费服务**；**⭐ 其派生字段**归** Donald Simpson Limited**；**⭐ 其公共部门信息部分**适用** Open Government Licence v3.0**。**⚠️ 本条目**不构成任何使用许可**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者与公司**（**CarHunch 与 Donald Simpson Limited**）**的实际关系与注册信息**；**也未核实该数据集与 CarHunch 线上站点显示的数字是否一致**（**⭐ 本次**未访问该站点**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实其与** DVSA **官方发布**的关系**（**⭐ 描述自述**不与 DVSA／DVLA 有关联或获其背书**，**本词条**只转述**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核实 **Kaggle** 上的**版本 4** **与** Hugging Face／GitHub 上同名样本**是否同一份**（**⭐ 描述称**同一份样本**，**但本次**未逐平台比对**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 数据集**最后更新 2026-09-10（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**其内容快照日逐字为 **2026-09-06**（**恰在窗口边界**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**其统计**只覆盖 MOT 记录**，**不含融资、**全损与车主历史**，**不得**用于任何具体的核保或定价判断**。

**uk-vehicle-reliability-sample**（Kaggle 資料集 `donaldmsimpson/uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset`，**逐字標題** `UK Vehicle Reliability: Volvo MOT Sample`**）**是一份**英國車輛可靠性隊列統計**的**免費評估樣本****——**逐字自述為**「**Cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics derived from DVSA MOT test records: first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at make × model × manufacture year × fuel type.**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本 4**、**1,225,083 位元組**、**可用性評分 0.94**、**下載 20 次、**瀏覽 45 次、**收藏 4**；**標籤逐字含** `tabular`、`automobiles and vehicles`、`transportation`、`insurance`**；**⭐ 許可欄位逐字為**「**Other (specified in description)**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：抽樣**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Kaggle 資料集頁的元數據與描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一句話劃清「**免費的是什麼**」****——**逐字**「**Nobody should pay for raw DVSA MOT data - the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence. This dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**原始資料是公共的**」與**「**能拿來做隊列統計的那一層不是**」**被分開**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**工程**」被具體化成**可核的歸一化比例****——**逐字**「**The DVSA feed has no model taxonomy, only free-text trim strings. For Volvo alone the source holds 4,030 raw model strings which normalise to 347 models**」**（**四個 `XC60 ...` 變體均歸為 `XC60`**）**；**全英逐字**「**216,686 distinct make-and-model combinations; normalisation coverage is 98.72%**」**，**並逐字**「**The join is documented in `NORMALISATION.md`, which is itself part of the product.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 缺陷嚴重度分類說明**哪些部分原始資料裡拿不到****——**逐字**「**A hand-built severity model applied at approximately 1.87 billion defect rows in production, rolled up to cohort level, giving weighted severity by tier (advisory, safety_wear, mechanical_safety, structural_concern, dangerous). This is the part that is not recoverable from the raw feed. Raw MOT failure text is dominated by consumables - tyres and brakes top almost every cohort, which tells you nothing.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**我加的不是資料，是分得清的類別**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 五處「**已替你修正**」逐條命名**：**未完成結果的抑制**（`pass_rate_reliable = false`**）**、**里程異常分離**（**真實調表約 4.5%**）**、**里程單位不可混**（`MI`／`KM` 約 0.6% 標錯，**逐字 do not average across units**）**、**混合動力按內燃機歸類**、**複檢不計入首次結果**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 產出檔案與行數列表**：`volvo_cohort_stats.parquet` 2,094 行、`volvo_defect_patterns.parquet` 5,029 行、`volvo_defect_severity.parquet` 6,284 行、`volvo_survival.parquet` 9,844 行、`volvo_mileage_band_pass.parquet` 2,860 行、`volvo_mileage_percentiles.parquet` 175 行、`volvo_preview.csv` 20 行**；**逐字**「**Every file carries `snapshot_date`, `generated_at` and `source`**」**；**快照日逐字** `2026-09-06`**、**篩選 `vehicle_count > 50`**、**隊列 2,094**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 局限逐條寫出，**並指出最容易用錯的欄位**：**僅 MOT 記錄**、**小於閾值的隊列被排除**、**`pass_rate_reliable = false` 須過濾**、**燃料標籤不完美**，**以及逐字**「**`vehicle_count` is not the mileage denominator. Use `mileage_sample_count`**」**，**並給出反例**（**1988 年的 `340` 有 14,085 輛車、**零條可用讀數，**故其 `avg_mileage` 為 `NULL`**）**；**以及**「**Snapshot, not a live feed.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 許可與歸屬分三層寫清**：**許可**「**evaluation only - this is not an open dataset**」**（**逐字** You may download, inspect and evaluate it. You may not redistribute it or use it in a production product, underwriting model or paid service without a commercial licence.**）**；**公共部門資訊** Open Government Licence v3.0**；**派生欄位歸屬** © Donald Simpson Limited**，**並逐字聲明不與 DVSA／DVLA 有關聯或獲其背書**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 「**同一份樣本、三個平台**」被寫明**：**完整資料集與許可的聯繫頁**、**Hugging Face 位址**、**GitHub 位址**，**並逐字**「**This is not an export made for sale - it is the layer behind a live public site, so you can inspect the same figures rendered for humans at carhunch.com before licensing the files.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 覆蓋範圍與用途**：**全量包覆蓋 MOT classes 1–7**（**含摩托車與輕型商用車**）**，**本樣本按定義只有汽車**；**用途逐字列出五類**（**二手車保修與核保**、**經銷商／拍賣／再營銷**、**配件與服務修復平台**、**車輛資料商與車隊分析**、**研究者與記者**）**——**⭐ 而**其許可**禁止**未經商業許可**用於核保或生產**，**本詞條**如實並列這兩句**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 工程細節與可複現入口**：**給出** `pandas` 與 **DuckDB** 兩種讀法**，**並給出**先按 `pass_rate_reliable` 過濾、**再排序**的最小示例**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claim-handling-deadlines-us]]、[[insurance-datasets]]、[[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]]、[[copart-salvage-dataset]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[synthetic-resdac-claims]]、[[stressed-insurance-datasets]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**只給聚合、**只給一個品牌、**並寫明僅評估用的車檢統計樣本＋把哪一層免費、**哪一層是加工寫成一句話**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[uk-home-insurance-risk-map]]、[[copart-salvage-dataset]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **許可要寫明能與不能做什麼**；**② **只發聚合時**逐字聲明沒有個人資料**；**③ **每個檔案帶**快照日期與來源**；**④ **把「**看起來像分母但其實不是**」的欄位**用一個反例指出**；**⑤ **同一份內容在多平台時**說清哪一版可再分發**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有下載該資料集任何檔案**（**未取任何 parquet 或 CSV、**未計算任何通過率或生存曲線**），**不主張**其行數以外的任何數值結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實 Kaggle 的**下載是否需要登入**——**本次**只用公開元數據介面取到描述**，**未嘗試下載檔案**；**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** 4,030 → 347**、**216,686**、**98.72%**、**1.87 billion**、**4.5%／0.6%** 這些數字**（**只轉述描述**）**；**⚠️ 特別是**「**約 18.7 億行缺陷記錄**」**本次**無任何獨立核對**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實各 parquet 的**實際列名**（**描述稱** `SCHEMA.md` **有完整文檔，**本次未取得**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `pass_rate_reliable` **在資料裡的取值與佔比**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**生存曲線的**具體定義**，**也未核實** 1988 年 `340` 那個反例**是否與資料一致**。**⑦ ⚠️ **許可須逐條遵守**：**⭐ 該資料集**不是開放資料**，**不得再分發、**不得用於生產、**核保或付費服務**；**派生欄位歸** Donald Simpson Limited**；**公共部門資訊部分適用** Open Government Licence v3.0**。**⚠️ 本條目**不構成任何使用許可**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實作者與公司**的實際關係與註冊資訊**；**未核實該資料集與 CarHunch 線上站點數字是否一致**（**未訪問該站點**）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核實其與** DVSA **官方發布的關係**（**只轉述描述自述**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 未核實 Kaggle 上的**版本 4** 與 **Hugging Face／GitHub 同名樣本是否同一份**（**未逐平台比對**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最後更新 2026-09-10（**窗口內**）**，**而**內容快照日逐字為 **2026-09-06**（**恰在窗口邊界**）**——**如實並列**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 其統計**只覆蓋 MOT 記錄**，**不含融資、**全損與車主歷史**，**不得**用於任何具體的核保或定價判斷**。
e.body_en:
The Kaggle dataset uk-vehicle-reliability-dataset, titled as a UK vehicle reliability sample, **is a free evaluation sample of cohort-level UK vehicle reliability statistics** derived from vehicle inspection records, covering first-time pass rates, defect patterns, a severity taxonomy, mileage-band behaviour and survival curves at the grain of make, model, manufacture year and fuel type. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 4**, **about 1.2 megabytes**, **a usability rating of about 0.94**, twenty downloads, forty-five views, four votes and one public notebook, tagged with insurance, owned and created by the same person, and **licensed as other with terms specified in the description**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case sampling.**

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, one sentence separates what is free from what is not**: verbatim, nobody should pay for raw inspection data, since the anonymised release is free and open under the Open Government Licence, and this dataset is the engineering between that raw feed and a usable cohort statistic. **The free source and the paid processing layer are named separately rather than conflated, which matches the standing distinction between a source and what was generated from it.** **Second, the engineering is made concrete as a checkable normalisation ratio**: verbatim, the feed has no model taxonomy, only free-text trim strings, and for one make alone the source holds four thousand and thirty raw model strings which normalise to three hundred and forty-seven models, illustrated with four strings that all reduce to the same model name; across the full bundle the source is stated to hold two hundred and sixteen thousand six hundred and eighty-six distinct make-and-model combinations with a normalisation coverage of about ninety-nine percent, and the join is documented in a normalisation document which the description calls part of the product. **That ratio is the answer to why inspection data cannot be grouped by model as it stands, and the normalisation rules are published as part of the product rather than kept inside it.** **Third, the defect severity taxonomy is explained as the part that cannot be recovered from the raw feed**: a hand-built severity model is stated to have been applied at approximately one point eight seven billion defect rows in production and rolled up to cohort level, giving weighted severity by five tiers separating structural failure such as corrosion, mounts and subframes from routine wear, with the description noting that raw failure text is dominated by consumables such as tyres and brakes, which tells you nothing. **What was added is not more data but categories that can be told apart.** **Fourth, five corrections already applied are named one by one**: suppression of incomplete outcomes through a reliability flag; separation of genuine odometer tampering, stated at about four and a half percent of vehicles, from typos and unit errors; a warning not to average across odometer units because roughly six in a thousand labels are wrong; hybrid vehicles classified by their combustion engine; and retests excluded from first-time outcomes. **Stating in advance which traps a naive pipeline falls into points the same way as the standing principles that a system must not degrade quietly and that a document should pre-empt misreading.** **Fifth, the outputs and their row counts are tabulated**: six Parquet files and one preview CSV with stated row counts of two thousand and ninety-four, five thousand and twenty-nine, six thousand two hundred and eighty-four, nine thousand eight hundred and forty-four, two thousand eight hundred and sixty, one hundred and seventy-five and twenty, with every file stated to carry a snapshot date, a generation timestamp and a source, the snapshot date being given as 2026-09-06, the filter as cohorts above fifty vehicles, and the cohort count as two thousand and ninety-four. **Every file carrying its own snapshot date and source is the most immediately useful of these conventions, because whoever receives the file does not have to guess which day it is a slice of.** **Sixth, the limitations are listed and one field is flagged as easy to misuse**: inspection records only, with no finance, write-off, stolen-marker or keeper history; cohorts below a floor excluded as statistically noisy; a reliability flag to filter on; fuel labels from the authority and imperfect; and the warning verbatim that the vehicle count is not the mileage denominator and that the mileage sample count should be used instead, illustrated by a nineteen eighty-eight model with fourteen thousand and eighty-five vehicles and zero usable readings whose average mileage is therefore null. **A column name that looks like a denominator but is not, demonstrated by a single counterexample, is worth copying.** **Seventh, licence and attribution are split into three layers**: the licence, stated as evaluation only and explicitly not an open dataset, permitting download, inspection and evaluation but not redistribution or use in a production product, an underwriting model or a paid service without a commercial licence; the public sector information layer under the Open Government Licence; and the derived fields, which are attributed to a named company, with an explicit statement that the product is not affiliated with or endorsed by the vehicle agencies. **One dataset carrying three distinct rights positions is a cleaner treatment than separating only data licensing from code licensing.** **Eighth, the same sample is declared to exist on three platforms**, with links to the full dataset, a Hugging Face dataset and a GitHub repository, and the statement verbatim that this is not an export made for sale but the layer behind a live public site, so the same figures can be inspected rendered for humans before licensing the files. **Ninth, coverage and audiences are stated**: the full bundle covers inspection classes one to seven including motorcycles and light commercial vehicles while this sample is cars only by definition, and the audiences are listed as used-car warranty and underwriting, dealer, auction and remarketing tools, parts and repair platforms, vehicle data providers and fleet analytics, and researchers and journalists. **This entry notes plainly that the description points at reserving use while the licence forbids unlicensed production or underwriting use, and records both without reconciling them.** **Tenth, the engineering surface is given**: two ways to read the files and a minimal example that filters on the reliability flag before ranking cohorts, **and the order of those two steps is itself the discipline**. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance data resources, a UK risk map, salvage vehicle valuation, data tooling and synthetic claims, **while this entry supplies a car-inspection sample that is aggregated only, limited to one make, licensed for evaluation only, and accompanied by a one-sentence statement of which layer is free and which is manufactured. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled UK risk map and the pooled salvage dataset**; **five practices transfer directly: state in the licence what may and may not be done, including production and underwriting exclusions; declare verbatim that aggregates contain no personal data; carry a snapshot date and source on every file; point out a field that looks like a denominator but is not, using one counterexample; and when one dataset exists on several platforms, say which version may be redistributed**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — no Parquet or CSV retrieved, no pass rate or survival curve computed — **so beyond the row counts stated in the description, no numerical result is claimed**. **Second, whether downloading from the platform requires signing in was not verified**: only public metadata endpoints were used to retrieve the description, and no file download was attempted, **so whether the stated free evaluation sample needs an account at the point of use is unverified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the figures for raw model strings, distinct make-and-model combinations, normalisation coverage, defect rows and the tampering and mislabelling percentages were not independently checked**, this entry relaying the description only, and **in particular the production scale of about one point eight seven billion defect rows has no independent corroboration here**. **Fourth, the actual column names in the output files were not verified**, the description pointing to a schema document that was not obtained. **Fifth, the distribution of the reliability flag was not verified.** **Sixth, the precise definition of the survival curves and whether the counterexample about the nineteen eighty-eight model matches the data were not verified.** **Seventh, the licence must be followed literally**: this entry states plainly that the dataset is not open data, may not be redistributed and may not be used in production, underwriting or a paid service, that its derived fields belong to a named company, and that its public sector information component is under the Open Government Licence; **nothing here constitutes a licence to use it**. **Eighth, the relationship between the author and the named company was not verified, nor was the dataset compared against the figures shown on the live site**, which was not visited. **Ninth, the relationship to the official authority publication was not verified**, only the description disclaimer being relayed. **Tenth, whether the platform version and the same-named samples on two other platforms are identical was not verified.** **Eleventh, on the window: the dataset was last updated 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, while its content snapshot date is stated as 2026-09-06, exactly at the window boundary, and this entry records both dates side by side. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the statistics cover inspection records only, with no finance, write-off or keeper history, and must not be used for any specific underwriting or pricing judgement.**
